name: Basic document retrieval
description: Retrieve relevant passages from an indexed corpus without per-user permission filtering.

name: Permission-aware document retrieval
description: Retrieve relevant passages from an indexed corpus while enforcing the caller's own access entitlements, not a shared service-account scope.

name: Document ingestion & chunk indexing
description: Ingest, chunk, and index source documents so they are retrievable, with a re-indexing path when sources change.

name: Document-level citation resolution
description: Attribute a generated answer back to the source document it was grounded in.

name: Span-level citation resolution
description: Attribute a generated answer back to the specific passage/span of the source document it was grounded in, not just the document.

name: Entity relationship traversal
description: Traverse a maintained entity/relationship graph to answer multi-hop questions a single retrieval pass cannot.

name: Conversational session management
description: Maintain multi-turn conversational state and context for a synchronous, interactive experience.

name: Structured output constraint
description: Constrain model output to a validated schema (JSON, form fields) rather than free text.

name: Image / scanned-document understanding
description: Extract information from images, scans, or diagrams as model input.

name: Batch / scheduled orchestration
description: Run a pipeline against a volume of records on a schedule or trigger, without a human waiting synchronously.

name: Tool invocation gateway
description: Invoke a bounded set of external tools/systems on the model's behalf, with logging of every call.

name: Task planning & decomposition
description: Decompose a goal into an ordered or dynamic sequence of steps rather than following a fixed script.

name: Multi-agent orchestration
description: Coordinate multiple independently-scoped agents toward a shared objective, with handoff and result reconciliation.

name: Action authorisation with approval workflow
description: Route a proposed system-mutating action through a human approval step before it executes.

name: Identity propagation to downstream systems
description: Carry the calling user's identity through to every downstream data or action call, rather than a shared service identity.

name: Approved model serving
description: Serve model inference only through models on the approved list, in the required network/region zone.

name: Fine-tuning / domain adaptation pipeline
description: Train or adapt a model on proprietary examples to change its style, format, or vocabulary behaviour.

name: High-volume classification / scoring
description: Classify or score a large batch of records against a fixed label set.

name: Input/output guardrails
description: Filter untrusted input and model output for injection attempts, policy violations, and PII/PHI leakage.

name: Evaluation harness
description: Continuously measure output quality against a labelled or rubric-based test set so regressions are detectable.

name: Observability & tracing
description: Capture trace, cost, latency, token, tool-call and retrieval logs for every request.

name: PHI/PII-safe logging
description: Ensure sensitive data is redacted or excluded from prompt/response logs and telemetry.

name: Audit logging with subject traceability
description: Log every access/action with enough detail to answer 'who accessed what, when, and why' during an audit.

name: Human oversight / review workflow
description: Route output through a human review step, from post-hoc sampling up to mandatory pre-action approval.
